Initiation-position and fork-asymmetry heterogeneity per IZ

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
summarize_track_features.Rd

Per IZ, remove the replication-progress trend from the relative initiation position and the fork asymmetry of its tracks (correct_signal_matrix(); plain centring with fewer than 4 tracks) and summarise means, medians and the spread (SD, MAD, IQR, variance) of the residuals.

Usage

summarize_track_features(
  track_intervals,
  method = c("spline", "bin"),
  n_progress_bins = 10L,
  spline_df = 4L,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

track_intervals

prepare_iz_data()$track_intervals.

method, n_progress_bins, spline_df

Correction settings.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over IZs.

Value

A list with summary (one row per IZ), track_intervals (with position_residual and fork_asymmetry_residual) and correction_method.
